annotations.title: What life phase each person is in, and what changes next

description: For one saved person or everyone saved on the account: the life chapter they are in now (Vimshottari Mahadasha) and the current phase within it (Antardasha), with dates, plus what comes next and when, sorted by whose phase changes soonest. Use when the user asks why life feels stuck or is shifting, when things will change, what is changing for someone this year, or about timing for family members. Read-only. Only for people saved on the user's AstroCalc account (needs a free AstroCalc sign-in); birth details typed in the chat work without sign-in in free_kundli, kundli_milan, explain_dasha, full_chart and life_timeline.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: 'en' (English, default) or 'hi' (Hindi).

profile.description: A saved kundli on the user's AstroCalc account: its name as listed by my_profiles (e.g. 'Mummy') or its id. Omit for all saved kundlis.
